app.rules.title: Rules
app.rules.teaser: Refuse changes or fill in fields, with CEL
app.rules.description: Rules check every change before it is made: a validate rule refuses changes its expression matches, and a default rule fills in fields of new resources. Try a rule on a change before you save it.
app.rules.listHelp: They apply to every change on the server. Turning one off or on is a change you preview first.

app.safeMode.title: Safe mode
app.safeMode.help: Safe mode takes every add-on out of the pipeline and stops it, so a misbehaving add-on can't keep the panel from working. Modules and rules keep working.

app.updates.title: Updates
app.updates.teaser: Release channel, automatic updates and Debian upgrades
app.updates.description: Racksail checks for releases on its channel every day. Releases are signed, checked before they install, installed after a snapshot of the system, and rolled back by themselves when they don't come up healthy.
app.updates.notSetUp: Updates are set up when the panel first starts.
app.updates.last: {state, select, installed {The update from {from} to {to} is waiting to confirm it works.} confirmed {Updated from {from} to {to}.} rolledBack {The update from {from} to {to} was rolled back: {reason}} other {}}

app.updates.channelHelp: Stable releases are tested the longest. Beta and nightly builds come first and may break.
app.updates.mirrorsHelp: One https URL per line, tried before GitHub. Mirrors serve each release under its tag, and signatures are checked all the same.
app.updates.debianNext: {codename} is the next major release. Every module is asked first, the system is snapshotted, and the server needs a reboot afterwards.
app.updates.reboot: The server needs a reboot to finish an upgrade.
app.updates.packagesSecurity: Install Debian's security updates as they come out
app.updates.packagesScheduled: Install every other update once a day, after snapshots of the system
app.updates.packagesReboot: Reboot by itself when an update needs it
app.updates.packagesHelp: Every other update includes those of vendors' repositories, such as PHP's. Held packages, such as a database version waiting for a tested upgrade, stay as they are.

error.core.unavailable: {what} isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.

error.addons.manifest: The add-on's manifest can't be used: {reason}.
error.addons.safe_mode: Safe mode is on, so no add-on runs: {reason}

error.agent.conflict: The {op} operation conflicts with the machine's state: {reason}.
error.agent.invalid_input: The {op} operation was given invalid input: {reason}.
error.agent.not_allowed: The {op} operation isn't allowed to touch {target}.
error.agent.not_found: The {op} operation couldn't find what it needs: {reason}.
error.agent.unknown_operation: The agent has no operation called {op}.
error.api.address_not_allowed: The panel doesn't accept requests from {address}.
error.api.no_sign_in: This panel has no way to sign anyone in yet, so it refuses requests that need a signed-in user.
error.changeset.action_not_repeated: {title} stopped while running {action}, which a retry doesn't run a second time. Run {action} again instead.
error.changeset.bad_contribution: {source} added a change hooks can't add: {reason}.
error.changeset.conflicts: The change has {count} conflicting contributions from hooks. Resolve them before applying it.
error.changeset.contribution_denied: {source} added a change you aren't allowed to make: {reason}
error.changeset.duplicate_request: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still being processed. Try again in a moment.
error.changeset.empty: The request doesn't ask for any changes.
error.changeset.hook_tampered: A hook changed {what}, which hooks can't change, so the change was stopped.
error.changeset.not_applied: Only applied changes can be undone.
error.changeset.not_preview: {title} isn't a preview, so it can't be applied again.
error.changeset.not_retryable: Only a change that failed can be carried out again, and {title} is {state}.
error.changeset.nothing_to_undo: {title} can't be undone because it didn't change any settings.
error.changeset.preview_has_secrets: {title} carried secret values, which previews don't keep. Send the change again to apply it.
error.changeset.preview_stale: {title} would now do something other than its preview showed. Look at the new preview, {preview}, and apply that instead.
error.changeset.snapshot_failed: The snapshot taken before {title} failed, so nothing was changed: {reason}
error.changeset.still_removing: {what} is still being removed. Try again when the removal has finished.

error.hooks.failed: {hook} didn't answer in time or failed, and it blocks changes when that happens.
error.hooks.invariant: {hook} tried to loosen {setting}, which only a hook with core.override may do.
error.hooks.overstep: The hook changed {what}, which hooks can't change.
error.hooks.rolled_back: {service} didn't work with the new configuration, so the previous one was put back: {reason}.
error.hooks.unknown_point: There is no hook point called {point}.
error.jobs.already_retried: This job was retried already, as {job}. If that one failed too, retry it instead.
error.jobs.interrupted: The panel stopped while this job was running. Retry it to run it again.
error.jobs.not_retryable: Only failed or canceled jobs can be retried.
error.jobs.unknown_type: There is no job type called {type}.
error.modules.busy: {module} is already being turned on or off. Try again when that has finished.
error.modules.created_by_system: Modules come with Racksail; the panel adds them itself.
error.modules.has_resources: {module} still has {count} resources, and it can't keep them while it is off. Delete them first, or remove the module with its data.
error.modules.in_use: {module} can't be turned off while {dependents} need it.
error.modules.not_deletable: Modules come with Racksail and can't be deleted. Turn {module} off or remove it instead.
error.modules.not_ready: The panel is still setting up {module}. Try again in a moment.
error.modules.nothing_to_turn_on: Every module of the {profile} profile that can run here is already on.
error.modules.off: {module} is off. Turn it on first.
error.modules.opt_in: {software} is only installed when an admin allows it in {module}'s settings.
error.modules.remove_resources: Removing {module} deletes its {count} resources. Remove it with its data, or keep the data.
error.modules.required: {module} is required and can't be turned off.
error.notify.no_relay: Email can't be sent until an admin sets up the mail relay in the notification settings.
error.notify.not_a_person: Notification preferences belong to people. Sign in with your own user to set yours.
error.notify.unknown_channel_type: There is no channel type or notifier called {type}.

error.recipes.marketplace_off: Catalogs are only fetched while the marketplace module is on.

error.recipes.module_off: {name} needs the {module} module. Turn it on first.

error.recipes.scope: Install into an account or onto the server.

error.secrets.bad_ref: {ref} isn't a secret reference; use the owner's id, a slash and the secret's name.
